question: How was the teaching transmitted among the earth-moving yoginīs?
premises: The recipients are earth-moving yoginīs described as good eaters.
The teaching was told to them.
inference: The teaching was transmitted by an earth-mover to the earth-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The epithet subhakṣāṇāṃ is unusual and its precise connotation is uncertain.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told by an earth-mover to the earth-moving yoginīs, the good eaters.
